name: loan-ai-underwriting-copilot
description: Evidence-grounded AI underwriting copilot. Consumes loan-structured-output, produces completeness, consistency, risk and summary artefacts, and routes uncertain or high-risk packets to a human underwriter.

functions.name: validate_packet_completeness
functions.description: Checks required documents and extracted fields; never invents missing values.

functions.name: build_borrower_context
functions.description: Normalises extracted values into one borrower view with source references.

functions.name: cross_document_reasoning
functions.description: Deterministic normalised comparisons across documents, each with evidence.

functions.name: assess_financial_risk
functions.description: Transparent demo risk indicators (not a credit score).

functions.name: generate_underwriting_summary
functions.description: NVIDIA-hosted LLM produces a schema-validated, evidence-grounded brief.

functions.name: route_by_confidence_and_risk
functions.description: Deterministic routing to READY_FOR_UNDERWRITER or HUMAN_REVIEW.

functions.name: capture_reviewer_feedback
functions.displayName: 7. Capture reviewer feedback as ground truth
functions.description: Writes reviewer-approved output to a dedicated folder in loan-ground-truth. Never overwrites existing items.
